issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath N1 §8.6 Identifiers: delimited identifiers are enclosed in backticks and FHIRPath string escape sequences also work for delimited identifiers.
issues.root_cause: Native lexer scanned delimited identifiers to the next raw backtick; Python identifier normalization stripped backticks globally instead of applying string-style escape decoding.
issues.resolution: Added native readDelimitedIdentifier(); Python identifier() now unescapes delimited content; member/env lookup no longer deletes interior backticks.
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: pytest aggregate/literal/arithmetic parity, native SQL 272 assertions, full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath N1 §8.5 Keywords and §8.7 Case-Sensitivity: keywords are case-sensitive; §8.3 Quantity literals allow datetime precision specifiers such as month, not differently-cased identifiers.
issues.root_cause: Python parse() walked parser.expression() without checking EOF, allowing a valid prefix to ignore trailing tokens.
issues.resolution: Added EOF check after parser.expression(); adjusted wrapper lexical precheck to mask escaped delimited identifiers.
issues.verified_in: Iteration 1: direct core regression tests, native/fallback fhirpath_is_valid parity, full conformance 2822/2822
